The questions I get

Still unsure about something? Ask directly, an answer costs nothing.

tabs.item_title: I already have a website. Can you work with it?
tabs.item_content: Yes. A rebuild is not always the answer. If the existing site is structurally sound, fixing speed, structure and SEO is usually faster and cheaper than starting over. I will tell you which one your site needs after looking at it.

tabs.item_title: How much does a website cost?
tabs.item_content: It depends on how many pages you need, whether you are selling online, and how much of the content already exists. Rather than list a number that will not match your situation, I quote after the discovery call, and the quote is fixed. No hourly surprises.

tabs.item_title: What do you need from me to start?
tabs.item_content: Your business details, any brand assets you already have, and a rough idea of what you want visitors to do. If you do not have copy or photos yet, say so early, that is usually what decides the timeline.

tabs.item_title: Will I be able to update the site myself?
tabs.item_content: That is the intention. Everything is built in Elementor with a clean structure, and handover includes a walkthrough of how to edit pages, add posts and manage your content.

tabs.item_title: Do you handle hosting and maintenance?
tabs.item_content: I can advise on hosting and set it up with you, and I take on maintenance and troubleshooting work separately, including plugin conflicts, critical errors and speed issues on sites I did not build.

tabs.item_title: How soon will SEO show results?
tabs.item_content: Not immediately, and anyone promising otherwise is guessing. The technical foundation is in place at launch, but ranking movement depends on your industry, competition and starting point. I will give you a realistic view after auditing the site rather than a number now.
